sentences.en: 'How have I changed?' he asked silkily.

sentences.en: With instant refreshing effects, it can make the skin moister and more silkily smooth and shine with healthiness.

sentences.en: "I had no idea, Wormtail, that you were craving more dangerous assignments, " said Snape silkily. "This can be easily arranged: I shall speak to the Dark Lord —"
